name: St. Croix Data Center / CentriLogic USVI
notes: Confirmed operational colocation/data-center activity on St. Croix. Epic.io lists a carrier-neutral St. Croix data center with direct subsea connectivity and facility details; Data Center Map lists one St. Croix facility, CentriLogic USVI; USVIEDA describes 64 West/RTPark managed services and colocation with a point of presence/data center traversing AT&T and Level 3/Global Crossing fiber switching facilities. Capacity not publicly stated.
